title: Guest From the Past
statementMd:
Kolya Gerasimov loves kefir very much. He lives in year 1984 and knows all the details of buying this delicious drink. One day, as you probably know, he found himself in year 2084, and buying kefir there is much more complicated.

Kolya is hungry, so he went to the nearest milk shop. In 2084 you may buy kefir in a plastic liter bottle, that costs $*a*$ rubles, or in glass liter bottle, that costs $*b*$ rubles. Also, you may return empty glass bottle and get $*c*$ ($*c* < *b*$) rubles back, but you cannot return plastic bottles.

Kolya has $*n*$ rubles and he is really hungry, so he wants to drink as much kefir as possible. There were no plastic bottles in his 1984, so Kolya doesn't know how to act optimally and asks for your help.

## Input

First line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$) — the number of rubles Kolya has at the beginning.

Then follow three lines containing integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ ($1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{18}$, $1 ≤ *c* < *b* ≤ 10^{18}$) — the cost of one plastic liter bottle, the cost of one glass liter bottle and the money one can get back by returning an empty glass bottle, respectively.

## Output

Print the only integer — maximum number of liters of kefir, that Kolya can drink.

## Note

In the first sample, Kolya can buy one glass bottle, then return it and buy one more glass bottle. Thus he will drink $2$ liters of kefir.

In the second sample, Kolya can buy two plastic bottle and get two liters of kefir, or he can buy one liter glass bottle, then return it and buy one plastic bottle. In both cases he will drink two liters of kefir.
statementZhMd:
科利亚·格拉西莫夫非常喜欢开菲尔。他生活在 1984 年，了解购买这种美味饮料的所有细节。然而，正如你可能已经知道的那样，有一天他来到了 2084 年，而在那里购买开菲尔要复杂得多。

科利亚饿了，于是他去了最近的牛奶商店。在 2084 年，你可以购买装在塑料一升瓶中的开菲尔，价格为 $*a*$ 卢布；也可以购买装在玻璃一升瓶中的开菲尔，价格为 $*b*$ 卢布。此外，你还可以退回空玻璃瓶并获得 $*c*$（$*c* < *b*$）卢布，但塑料瓶无法退回。

科利亚有 $*n*$ 卢布，而且他非常饿，所以他想尽可能多地喝开菲尔。1984 年没有塑料瓶，因此科利亚不知道如何做出最优选择，于是向你求助。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$）——科利亚一开始拥有的卢布数。

接下来三行分别包含整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$（$1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{18}$，$1 ≤ *c* < *b* ≤ 10^{18}$）——一瓶塑料瓶装开菲尔的价格、一瓶玻璃瓶装开菲尔的价格，以及退回空玻璃瓶后可以获得的钱数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——科利亚最多可以喝到的开菲尔升数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，科利亚可以先购买一瓶玻璃瓶装开菲尔，然后退回瓶子，再购买一瓶玻璃瓶装开菲尔。因此，他可以喝到 $2$ 升开菲尔。

在第二个样例中，科利亚可以购买两瓶塑料瓶装开菲尔，喝到两升开菲尔；或者购买一瓶玻璃瓶装开菲尔，然后退回瓶子，再购买一瓶塑料瓶装开菲尔。这两种情况下他都可以喝到两升开菲尔。
